lines.en: I walk on my tentacles.
I hop step by step, lightly.
My head is big and my feet are small.
I walk along the edge of the blocks.

lines.zh: 我晃着往前走，像随时会倒。
lines.en: I wobble forward as if about to fall.

lines.zh: 我的触手在地上留下湿印。
lines.en: My tentacles leave damp marks.
I skirt that deep gap.
I hop up a step, then down.
I creep along the wall base.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直盯着前面。
lines.en: My eyes stay fixed ahead.
Three steps, then a pause.
I reach forward, tentacle first.
I squat on the block, tentacles curled.
My eyes swivel apart.
I sort my tentacles one by one.

lines.zh: 我不动，风把我的触手吹起来。
lines.en: I stay still; the wind lifts my tentacles.
I count the blocks under me.
My head is heavier than my body.
I suction my tentacles to the ground.
I puff up, then deflate.
You stepped on my block.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛分得很开。
lines.en: I look up, eyes far apart.

lines.zh: 我蹲在你鞋边那格砖上。
lines.en: I squat on the block by your shoe.
There is dirt on your shoes.
I put out one tentacle.
Don't kick me with your boot tip.
I push my head upward.
Do you have star bits on you?
I hop and can't reach you.
I roll half a turn.
My tentacle is squashed.
I bounce off and hit a block.
That left me dizzy.

lines.zh: 我把触手全收进头底下。
lines.en: I pull every arm under my head.
My eyes won't focus.
I retreat into the block seam.
I shake my tentacles.
I still have hops in me.
I slowly puff my courage back up.
That shiny thing — is it a star bit?
Just one star bit, please.

lines.zh: 我闻不到味道，但我想要。
lines.en: I can't smell it, but I want it.

lines.zh: 我转着圈，就为那颗紫星屑。
lines.en: I spin in circles for that purple stardust.
I jump for it.
Dropped ones, I pick up myself.
How many do you have?
I'm not greedy. Just one.
Spread them out.
My tentacle wraps your foot.
I bounce off and come back.
Don't step on my head.
I'm lighter than you; I can't win a shove.
We bump with a soft sound.
I fall on the block and roll over.
You pushed me off the step.
I grab the seam and climb back.
You step back and I make way.
I am something like an octopus.
There aren't many of us.
Don't step on me with your foot.
I have drawn my tentacles in.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候我抬头看着。
lines.en: I look up while you talk.
This is the wrong season.
I don't have a nest yet.
You're too tall; I can't reach.
I squeeze into a block seam.
Another time. I'm off.
I wind a tentacle twice around it.
This fits in my mouth.
This block is a bit hard.
I hide it under a block.
Is this a star bit? No.
I roll it up and stow it.
I want everything that falls.

lines.zh: 我八条触手一起抱着挪。
lines.en: I carry it hugged by all eight arms.
This is bigger than me.
You stepped on my block.
I gather myself and leap at your waist.
My tentacles are already spread.
You're taller; I'll hit your legs.
These steps are mine.
Three hops and I leap.
You're at the edge.
I bounce, testing my reach.
My eyes are on your feet.
Don't try to jump past.
I shift toward you.
You can't outrun me; I hop.
I hop twice, testing the distance.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块砖我记住了。
lines.en: I remember which block you stepped on.

lines.zh: 我把触手从砖下抽出来。
lines.en: I pull my tentacles from under the block.
I want the star bits in your hand.
I follow you, hop by hop.
Each of your steps, I hop twice.
One hop takes me to your other side.
I wait in the block seam.
Your steps make the blocks ring.
I have puffed up again.
Don't run up the steps.
My tentacles arrive first.
Do you hear the bouncing?
One more block of hopping.
The steps behind you are too high.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上跳到你侧面。
lines.en: I hop from the step to your flank.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直对着你的脚。
lines.en: My eyes stay on your feet.
I puffed up another size.
I wait for you in the block seam.
I have counted each of your steps.
I go around beneath the steps.
You've reached the edge.
I bounce up and land again.
My tentacle whips across.
That one bounced high.
I throw my whole body at you.
The butt sends you back half a step.

lines.zh: 触手一圈一圈绕住脚踝。
lines.en: My arms coil round your ankle.
I bounce back in.
I throw my whole body at you.
A tentacle nooses your wrist.

lines.zh: 我的头磕在你的膝盖上。
lines.en: My head knocks your knee.

lines.zh: 这一下用上了弹跳的力。
lines.en: That one used my bounce.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚往下拽。
lines.en: I bite your trouser leg and pull down.
You stagger and I cling on.
I roll a turn and hit you again.
The block under you has loosened.
I wrap both your feet.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我抱住了你。
lines.en: Not heavy, but I have hold of you.
These steps are good.
My tentacles are still wet.
I look up; sky above the blocks.
My marks are on the block.
I puff up for the first time.

lines.zh: 这里有很多星屑的味道。
lines.en: There is a smell of star bits here.
I squat and count blocks.
I try one hop.

lines.zh: 风把我的触手吹得直晃。
lines.en: The wind swings my tentacles.
I picked a good spot.
I hear someone above.
My tentacles recoil from fire.
I rolled down the steps.
Water fills my head; it feels swollen.
The blast blows me off my feet.
Something struck my head.
Violet light dazzles me.
I haven't had a star bit in ages.

lines.zh: 雷声一响，我整个缩起来。
lines.en: At the thunder I shrink entirely.
The blocks are gone and I fall.
